# Daily Motivation Quotes

> A curated collection of powerful motivational quotes and in-depth success stories of legendary figures who overcame immense adversity.

## Key Features
- **Daily Quotes**: Randomized motivational quotes from various thinkers and leaders.
- **Success Stories**: Deep-dive articles into the lives of people who redefined the limits of human achievement.
- **Interactive UI**: Clean, glassmorphic design optimized for focus and inspiration.

## Motivational Stories
- [Sylvester Stallone's Rocky Journey](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/rocky.html): How a broke actor refused to sell his script unless he starred in it.
- [Steve Jobs' Comeback](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/steve-jobs.html): From being fired by Apple to revolutionizing the world with Pixar and returning to save Apple.
- [The Cinderella Man: James J. Braddock](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/james-braddock.html): A dockworker's rise from the Great Depression breadlines to world heavyweight champion.
- [Wilma Rudolph](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/wilma-rudolph.html): Paralyzed by polio as a child, she became the fastest woman on Earth.
- [Ludwig van Beethoven](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/beethoven.html): Composing his greatest masterpieces in complete silence after going deaf.
- [Sara Blakely (Spanx)](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/spanx.html): Building a billion-dollar empire from $5,000 and a simple idea.
- [Niki Lauda](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/niki-lauda.html): The most courageous comeback in sports history after a near-fatal F1 crash.
- [Jan Koum (WhatsApp)](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/whatsapp.html): From standing in food stamp lines to a $19 billion acquisition.
- [Andre Agassi](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/andre-agassi.html): Reclaiming his life and tennis career after hitting rock bottom.
- [Robert Downey Jr.](https://www.dailymotivationquotes.com/stories/robert-downey-jr.html): A remarkable journey of redemption from prison to "Iron Man."

## Technical Stack
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS
- JSON-driven data for quotes and stories
- GitHub Pages hosting
- Native Web Share API integration
